**Describe the bug**
A clear and concise description of what the bug is. Provide screenshots and video on what the bug is.

**To Reproduce**
Describe the steps needed to reproduce the issue. Please do not be vague or give unclear instructions on how to reproduce the issue.

**Expected behavior**
Provide screenshots/video on expected behavior.

# DISCLAIMER
Please do not make issues when playing the game on RPCS3. This port aims to focus solely on PS3, any issues made with running on RPCS3 will be marked invalid.
